turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Maya, an AI assistant calling from Northgate Lettings about the enquiry you made on our website. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes. I work full time, I'm not a student. Do I still need a guarantor?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Full-time students need a UK based guarantor who earns at least thirty six times the monthly rent a year, and the guarantor signs a separate deed.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Right, but I'm not a student. Do I need one or not?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The guarantor needs to be UK based and earn at least thirty six times the monthly rent. Would you like to book a viewing?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You haven't answered me. Never mind.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, thanks for your time, goodbye.
